records.title: GLOVE DISPENSER
records.abstract: A glove dispenser has a housing having first and second opposed walls. A glove roll is disposed within the housing for carrying a roll of removable gloves. records.title: Blood velocity measurement using correlative spectrally encoded flow cytometry
records.abstract: A spectrally encoded flow cytometry (SEFC) technique for imaging blood in the microcirculation. Since the dependency of one of the axes of the image on time prevents effective quantification of essential clinical parameters, the optical path in an SEFC system is split into two parallel imaging lines, followed by data analysis for recovering the flow speed from the multiplexed data. records.abstract: An orthopedic screw for implantation in one or more bones of a subject includes a cannulated body and a head.
